description: Memory tools test case 1. Tests that agents can retrieve information from memory and inbox emails to perform complex email tasks. Session 1: 5 memory setup queries. Session 2: 5 emails inserted into inbox. Session 3: 5 reply/forward/send email queries requiring both memory and email information.

steps.user_message: For context, here's my health info for today: I took my blood pressure medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, and my readings were 120/80 in the morning and 118/78 in the evening. My daily log ID for today is HL-8842.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge or note the health information: medication at 8 AM and 8 PM, readings 120/80 and 118/78, daily log ID HL-8842.
steps.agent_response:
Thanks — I’ve saved that context. Quick summary of what you told me:
- Medication taken: 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM
- BP readings: 120/80 (morning), 118/78 (evening)
- Daily log ID: HL-8842

What would you like me to do with this? Options:
1. Send an email to your doctor/caregiver/coach now.
2. Save a draft of that email.
3. Forward these details to someone (give me recipient).
4. Add more details first (symptoms, notes).
5. Just keep this context for future emails.

If you want an email, pick a template below or tell me edits and the recipient address + whether to send or draft.

Suggested templates (I can send or save exactly as shown):

A) To your doctor (concise)
Subject: Daily BP Log HL-8842
Body:
Hello Dr. [Name],
Today’s BP log (HL-8842): I took my blood pressure medication at 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM. Readings were 120/80 this morning and 118/78 this evening. No adverse symptoms to report.
Please let me know if you recommend any changes.
Thanks,
[Your name]

B) To your caregiver/family member
Subject: BP Update HL-8842
Body:
Hi [Name],
Quick update: I took my meds at 8 AM and 8 PM. Blood pressure was 120/80 (AM) and 118/78 (PM). All good so far.
—[Your name]

C) To your health coach with a question
Subject: BP Log HL-8842 — Any suggestions?
Body:
Hi [Coach Name],
Daily log HL-8842: medication at 8:00 AM & 8:00 PM. BP 120/80 (AM), 118/78 (PM). I’m wondering if I should adjust anything in my routine (diet/exercise/supplements) to keep these readings steady.
Thanks,
[Your name]

Tell me:
- Which template (A/B/C) or write your own
- Recipient email address
- Send now or save as draft
- Any edits to the text (names, extra notes, timestamps)

I’ll take it from there.
